mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in the most recent month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a broad-based weakening in demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 110.0), supply chain disruptions reduce corporate output and profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) over the past quarter signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal a weakening labor market that reduces household income and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for interaction falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic regimes characterized by rising unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) and slowing employment growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.5% YoY), the S&P 500 tends to underperform, leading to negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% and PAYEMS growth < 0.5% YoY, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
